company.name: Corgi Insurance
company.shortDescription: Corgi Insurance is a business insurance provider that focuses on delivering coverage for startup and technology companies.
company.description: Corgi Insurance is a business insurance provider that focuses on delivering coverage for startup and technology companies through a digital, software-driven platform. It offers commercial insurance products such as general liability, cyber insurance, directors and officers liability, and professional liability, structured into modular plans that can be adjusted based on company stage and risk profile. The platform provides instant quoting and policy issuance workflows intended to reduce manual underwriting steps and broker involvement. It operates as a full-stack insurance carrier, meaning it manages underwriting, policy creation, and claims handling within its own system. The company also integrates AI-supported processes to evaluate risk and streamline insurance administration for business customers. Its services are primarily used by early-stage and scaling companies that require standardized coverage for contracts, fundraising, and operational risk management.
